title: Design and synthesis of asymmetric anhydrous quaternary ammonium fluoride electrolytes for fluoride ion batteries
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01432D, Paper

Tiancheng Tan, Richard Murdey, Shunsuke Sumitomo, Atsushi Wakamiya
Three novel asymmetric anhydrous quaternary ammonium fluoride salts with varying structural bulkiness were synthesized to reveal how structural variations influence chemical properties such as solubility, ionic conductivity, and stability.
